purpose: Blinded small-scale Moon/Mars-Earth morphology method review
limitations: All 24 reference queries and both Earth sites were used during research; held-out reference sites are isolated from neural training only, not from method design.
Earth gallery contains only Meteor Crater and Kilbourne Hole; controls are random within that restricted, overlapping pool, not verified negative analogs.
Reference and Earth DEM images contain no per-window mineral or mission conditions. U is appropriate for material and mission axes.
Review scores may support within-pool method comparison only; no global Earth retrieval recall or discovery claim.
